The ratio $\frac{K_P}{K_C}$ for the reaction:
$$\mathrm{CO_{(g)} + \frac{1}{2}O_{2(g)} \rightleftharpoons CO_{2(g)}}$$
is:
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{CO(g) + \frac{1}{2}O_2(g) \rightleftharpoons CO_2(g)}$
$$\Delta n_g = 1 - \left(1 + \frac{1}{2}\right) = -\frac{1}{2}$$
$$\frac{K_P}{K_C} = (RT)^{\Delta n_g} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{RT}}$$

questions.stem:
When 'x' $\times 10^{-2}$ mL methanol (molar mass = 32 g; density = 0.792 $\mathrm{g/cm^3}$) is added to 100 mL water (density = 1 $\mathrm{g/cm^3}$), the following diagram is obtained.
x =………………(nearest integer)
[Given: Molal freezing point depression constant of water at 273.15 K is $1.86\ \mathrm{K\,kg\,mol^{-1}}$]
questions.solution:
$\Delta T_f = 273.15 - 270.65 = 2.5\ \mathrm{K}$
$\Delta T_f = K_f\, m \Rightarrow 2.5 = 1.86 \times \frac{n}{0.1}$
$\Rightarrow n = 0.1344$ moles
$\Rightarrow w = 0.1344 \times 32 = 4.3\ \mathrm{g}$
$\text{Volume} = \frac{4.3}{0.792} = 5.43\ \mathrm{ml} = 543 \times 10^{-2}\ \mathrm{ml}$
